headline: Jorge I. Miranda posts summary of bronchiectasis symposium at GOLDCOPD2026
dek: The pulmonologist shared a thread summarising a CME symposium on bronchiectasis diagnosis, disease heterogeneity and emerging therapeutic strategies, held at GOLDCOPD2026.
body:
Jorge I. Miranda, who describes himself on X as an internist and pulmonologist, posted a thread summarising a continuing medical education (CME) symposium held at GOLDCOPD2026.

The session was titled "Bronchiectasis in Focus: Diagnosis, Disease Heterogeneity, and Emerging Therapeutic Strategies". According to Miranda's post, it featured Prof @ProfJDChalmers and Prof Mark Matersky.

Miranda wrote that the thread is his own summary of the symposium. The post linked to the thread but the text available does not set out the content of the presentations, so the specific points made by the speakers are not reported here.

The post was published on 7 November 2026.
key_quote: CME Symposium on Bronchiectasis in Focus: Diagnosis, Disease Heterogeneity, and Emerging Therapeutic Strategies
